name: Battle of Leuctra
note: The accounts give no ground and no compass directions, so none is drawn. The Spartans are shown on the right of the plan, facing left. Where the cavalry of each side stood is not stated: both are placed between the infantry lines. Where the Sacred Band stood is not known; it is drawn in front of the Theban column, as one reading has it. The accounts differ: in one the Thebans charge a Spartan line thrown into disorder by its own fleeing cavalry, in another a Spartan wing movement caught by Pelopidas, and only the first has a cavalry fight. The plan follows the first for the order of events. Cleombrotus and the Spartan royal bodyguard are not drawn separately.

phases.title: The armies draw up
phases.text: The Spartans stood with their own troops on the right and their allies on the left. Epaminondas set his Thebans in a very deep column on the left, opposite the Spartan right, with the other Boeotians further right and back.
phases.quote: placing it on the left, directly opposite Cleombrotus and the Spartan right.

phases.title: The cavalry meet and the Spartan horse is beaten
phases.text: The battle opened with a cavalry engagement between the lines. The Theban cavalry, the more experienced of the two, quickly defeated the Spartan cavalry.
phases.quote: The battle proper then opened with a cavalry engagement, in which the Spartan cavalry was quickly defeated.

phases.title: The Spartan cavalry flees and the Thebans charge
phases.text: The Spartan cavalry fled back through its own infantry and disordered the Spartan line just as the Thebans charged. The other Boeotians held back, by one account withdrawing gradually as they were attacked.
phases.quote: back through their own infantry, causing a disruption in the Spartan lines. Moreover, this occurred just as the Thebans were charging into them.

phases.title: The Spartan right holds, then is pushed back
phases.text: The Spartan line held long enough for the mortally wounded Cleombrotus to be carried off alive. It then fell back under the pressure of the Theban mass.
phases.quote: the Spartan line was able to hold long enough for the mortally wounded Cleombrotus to be carried off the field still alive

phases.title: The Spartan wing is routed and the left gives way
phases.text: The Spartan right wing was pushed back, turned, routed and fled. The Spartan left wing gave way when its men saw the right being pushed back.
phases.quote: when they saw that the right wing was being pushed back, gave way
